affected_party: people and AI agents relying on reviewed calibration thresholds
actual_problem: QIF v0.6.33 evaluates one declared action threshold but cannot show whether a small, plausible threshold change would flip the action or consequence class.
why_it_matters: A brittle decision can appear stable and authoritative even though it depends on an arbitrary boundary choice.
why_now: Consequence classification is executable, making bounded threshold sensitivity the nearest unclosed governance gap.
